lines.zh: 我靠着两条短腿在林间踱
lines.en: I pace the woods on two short legs.

lines.zh: 背着弩走路，重心有点偏
lines.en: With a crossbow on my back, my balance tilts.
I crunch through fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 木头的关节走起来会响
lines.en: My wooden joints creak as I walk.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边校准弩弦
lines.en: I tune the bowstring as I walk.

lines.zh: 林子里光线斑驳，我从影子里过
lines.en: Dappled light; I pass from shadow to shadow.

lines.zh: 我绕过一丛蕨，没有碰它
lines.en: I round a fern without touching it.

lines.zh: 这具身体是造出来的，走路像上了发条
lines.en: Made, not born; I walk like wound clockwork.

lines.zh: 我停一下，听弦有没有松
lines.en: I pause to check the string.

lines.zh: 小小的个子，走在草里只露半截
lines.en: Small enough that the grass hides half of me.

lines.zh: 我沿着林线走，那里风小
lines.en: I keep to the treeline where the wind is mild.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，像在找目标
lines.en: I walk a step, pause, as if searching.
My shadow stretches out.

lines.zh: 走到空地边缘，我不再往前
lines.en: At the clearing's edge, I go no further.

lines.zh: 我的脚步轻，木头的重量却明显
lines.en: Light steps, yet the wood is heavy.

lines.zh: 我掉头走回去，绕了半圈
lines.en: I turn and walk back, half a circle.

lines.zh: 我站在原地，弦已经拉满
lines.en: I stand still, string already drawn.
The stock rests on my forearm, steady.
I count the gaps in the wind.

lines.zh: 木头做的脸，看不出表情
lines.en: A wooden face shows no expression.
I calibrate by sound, not sight.
At any sound, the bow comes up first.
Short legs; I outrun no one.

lines.zh: 我在林间等，等到有人经过
lines.en: I wait in the woods for someone to pass.
The sun is low; the light comes slanting.

lines.zh: 我的箭头是塑能海晶石磨的
lines.en: My bolt heads are cut from evocation crystal.
A bird settles on a branch nearby.
The bowstring is slack; I wait for orders.

lines.zh: 这身炼金结构，能撑一阵
lines.en: This alchemical frame will last a while.
I adjust the angle slightly.

lines.zh: 我把弩抬起来，没有对准
lines.en: I raise the bow, not aiming yet.
You have entered my range.
I am calculating distance and wind.
You stand straight — a fine target.
My eyes are two small holes.
I aim at your shoulder, not your head.
Turn and I will loose.
A wooden finger rests on the trigger.

lines.zh: 地上一片落叶，我踩着它
lines.en: A fallen leaf; I stand on it.

lines.zh: 你的装备不错，我记下了
lines.en: Your gear is good; I have noted it.
A crack in my wood; I retreat.
My legs are unsteady.

lines.zh: 弩掉在地上，我弯腰去捡
lines.en: The bow drops; I bend to get it.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我一根弦
lines.en: That snapped a string.
The string slackened; I draw it tight again.
I back behind a tree and recalibrate.
Wood shavings fall everywhere.
The frame still holds.
I raise the bow at you.
Damage like this can be repaired.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这东西没用
lines.en: I do not eat; this is useless to me.

lines.zh: 是海晶石吗，我认得那光泽
lines.en: Is that evocation crystal? I know the sheen.
I reach out a wooden hand to take it.
This could be ground into a bolt head.
The weight of this bolt is wrong.

lines.zh: 你要是给弦蜡，我更高兴
lines.en: String wax would please me more.
I drop it into my back basket.
My fingers are too stiff to pinch it.
This can repair my bow.
Taken; I owe you one.
You bump me; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 木头身子很硬，撞上来会疼
lines.en: Wood is hard; hitting me hurts.
The bow nearly slips; I grip tighter.

lines.zh: 我们相撞，我的关节响了一声
lines.en: We collide and one of my joints clicks.
I am light, so you push me a little.
I set my base and stand again.

lines.zh: 这一撞把我的瞄准打断了
lines.en: That broke my aim.
I back behind a tree and rewind the string.
Leaves crunch wildly under us.
You should not stand this close.

lines.zh: 我是造出来的，没有这一类事
lines.en: I was made; such things are not for me.

lines.zh: 同批出厂的，也算同伴吧
lines.en: Those from the same batch; they count as kin, I suppose.

lines.zh: 我们两个一起校准，更准
lines.en: The two of us calibrating together is more accurate.
You keep the left wood, I the right.

lines.zh: 我们不用说话，听弦就够
lines.en: No words needed; the string tells enough.

lines.zh: 同一块木头做的，会一起朽
lines.en: Cut from the same wood, we will rot together.

lines.zh: 谁先坏了，另一个接着守
lines.en: Whoever breaks first, the other keeps watch.
Both our shadows are small.

lines.zh: 并排站的时候，角度正好
lines.en: Standing side by side, our angles line up.

lines.zh: 有你在，我不用一直转头
lines.en: With you here, I need not keep turning.
I cup it in both wooden hands.
It slips between my fingers.
I slot it into the bow's groove.
Enough for three bolt heads.
I pick it up and drop it in the basket.
Too heavy; I can only drag it.

lines.zh: 我举起来对着光看了看
lines.en: I hold it to the light and look.
Spare parts on the ground; I collect them.
I do not need this; leave it.
I stack them one by one.
Something has entered the woods.
Behind a tree, I draw first.
Enough distance, steady wind.

lines.zh: 它走的方向会经过我的准星
lines.en: Its path crosses my sight line.
I raise the bolt an inch.
No need to chase; let it come to me.
The light at this angle helps me.
My range is not wide, but it serves.
I wait for it to turn.
Finger tight, not yet loosed.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，从这棵树到那棵树
lines.en: I track it from tree to tree.
The string stays drawn.

lines.zh: 它往左，我把准星往左挪
lines.en: It moves left; my sight follows.
I count its steps.

lines.zh: 它要是冲过来，我先退一步
lines.en: If it charges, I step back first.
The instant the wind stops is best.
Short legs; I must not be closed on.
I know these woods; it does not.
Two more steps and it is in the kill zone.
I still my hand.
I loose a bolt.
The string snaps, briefly.
The bolt takes you in the leg.
I step back and rewind.
My wooden hand trembles.
The second bolt I aim lower.
I do not fight close; I fight far.
You are pinned between trunks.
That one grazed past.
I draw once more.

lines.zh: 育母的造物，被放在了林子里
lines.en: A brood-made thing set down in the woods.
I rise out of the leaf litter.
String not yet wound; I find cover first.

lines.zh: 林子里有脚步声，我听见了
lines.en: Footsteps in the wood; I hear them.

lines.zh: 我的木壳上还带着锯痕
lines.en: Saw marks still on my wooden shell.

lines.zh: 这不是自然生的，是人摆的
lines.en: Not naturally born; someone placed me.
I calibrate once before moving.

lines.zh: 海晶石的箭头在暗处发亮
lines.en: The crystal bolt heads glimmer in the dark.
I lean against a thick trunk.

lines.zh: 远处有鸟飞起，方向不对
lines.en: Birds lift far off, in the wrong direction.

lines.zh: 木头开始焦，我拍打着退开
lines.en: My wood chars; I slap at it and retreat.

lines.zh: 我摔在地上，一条腿折了
lines.en: I hit the ground; one leg snaps.

lines.zh: 水渗进木头的缝，我沉下去
lines.en: Water seeps into my seams; I sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我连弩一起掀翻
lines.en: The blast flips me and the bow together.
An arrow sticks in my shell.

lines.zh: 那股力让我的关节僵住
lines.en: That force locks my joints.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，所以不会饿
lines.en: I do not eat, so I do not starve.

lines.zh: 雷打在木壳上，我全身一麻
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell; everything goes numb.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，木头也抓不住
lines.en: No ground; even wood cannot grip.
